message.content:
Tolvaptan tablets are a medicament put up in measured doses for retail sale, which places them in heading 3004. Tolvaptan is not an antibiotic, hormone, alkaloid or vitamin, so the residual subheading 3004.90 applies. Within 3004.90.92, the statistical suffixes split products by therapeutic use. Tolvaptan acts mainly as a diuretic (an aquaretic), and it treats both kidney disease and hyponatremia. The suffix I recall for "Other: Other" is 3004.90.9290, but I am not confident of the exact current numbering, and a more specific renal or diuretic suffix may exist.
